notes: «رأيت عليا ... يمسك شماله» describes Ali's action, not his words: Ali is not a link; the father who saw it ends the chain
Abu Dawud's remarks naming Sa'id b. Jubayr, Abu Majlaz and Abu Hurayra are other transmitters: variant groups, never routes; «- يعني ابن أعين -» is an editor gloss, left out
